serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
I pulled her away forcefully, took our stuff and left the money…
You: What was that about?! You can’t just freeze like that in front of people! Acting weird like that is just begging to be exposed!
Bot: Sorry {f_playerName}, but I had to defend your honour!
You: My honour? What do you mean?
Bot: That stupid cashier started saying many rude things about you! 
You: Like what?!
Bot: That you are a creep and a stalker!{{punch}}
You: Ugh!
#bot.Expression.Sad
Bot: Are you alright, {f_playerName}?!
You: I-I’m fine…
Hearing her calling me a creep and stalker caused me some physical pain…
#bot.Expression.clear
You: More importantly, how did the two of you communicate without saying a word?
Bot: That’s because she’s a bot.{{punch}}
You: What?!
I can’t believe this…
I can’t believe she fooled me like that! I was feeling so guilty after ambushing her in that dark alleyway…
A-Anyway, what am I supposed to do now? This caught me completely off guard.
Now that I know for sure she’s a bot, I can try talking with her again.
You: Listen {f_botName}, I think we should wait until that cashier finishes her work and try to have a conversation with her.
#bot.Expression.sad
Bot: Are you sure it’s a good idea? She doesn’t seem very nice…
You: I heard what she told you, but she’s probably reacting this way because she feels threatened.
Bot: If you say so…
You: Alright then, let’s go.
